settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceHint: Choose how the logo at the top and the navigation menu look. Your choices stay on this device.
settings.backupHint: Export your entire library (series, volumes, chapters, reading progress, favorites) to a file you can keep or transfer to another device.
settings.backupModeFullHint: Also includes chapter thumbnails. Estimated size: {{size}}.
settings.backupModeLightHint: Without chapter thumbnails, which regenerate on their own the next time you open a chapter (series and volume covers are kept). Estimated size: {{size}}.
settings.restoreSummary: The file contains {{series}} series, {{volumes}} volumes and {{chapters}} chapters.
settings.restoreLightNote: This is a light backup: chapters won't have a thumbnail until you reopen them.
settings.invalidBackupFile: The chosen file is not a valid backup.
settings.unreadableBackupFile: Couldn't read the file: it's not a valid JSON backup.
settings.restoreWarning: The current library (series, volumes, chapters, progress, favorites) will be entirely replaced with the one from the chosen file. This action cannot be undone.
settings.restoreHandleHint: Restored chapters won't be readable right away: handles to physical files can never be exported (they're tied to this browser/device). Re-import the same files after restoring to reconnect them.
settings.restoreSuccess: Library restored. Chapters aren't readable yet: re-import the same files from the Library to reconnect them (they'll be recognized automatically, not duplicated).
settings.startPageHint: Automatic: at launch the Reader opens if you have already started reading, otherwise the Library. It only applies when the app starts.

pwa.updateAvailable: A new version of the app is available.
